title: Fourth-moment bound for affine forms
statement: For every natural number $n$, every real number $c$, and every coefficient vector $a\in\mathbb{R}^n$, let $X$ be the affine form $X(x)=c+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ on the uniform sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$. Its fourth moment is at most three times the square of its second moment: $\mathbb{E}[X^4]\le 3(\mathbb{E}[X^2])^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $1,\ldots,n$
the input is uniformly distributed on the sign cube
